t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I have noticed that some of the gnomes give you more mushrooms and points, a red gnome tends to offer double the amount of mushrooms compared to the green. hen selecting a specific gnome, I may gain or lose a minute or so.

vb_textbox.text: Every round takes 1.5 minutes so be very fast when choosing an answer. In a round there are patterns, one may contain the brightest gnomes to get the most mushrooms, while others have primary colors to get more mushrooms. Not every round has the same sequence, sometimes the rounds are random and there is no given sequence so go with your gut. During breaks, try not to leave your seat for long because it will automatically switch to the game and you will lose points if not presently playing.
